description: This file implements an in-memory repository for car data. It includes seeded sample data for cars, and provides functions to list cars with filtering, sorting, and pagination, as well as fetching individual cars by ID. It is intended for use in API endpoints without database dependencies.

classes.name: Car
classes.description: A data class representing car details, imported from the domain module.

methods.name: List[Car] _seed_cars()
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of sample Car objects for demo and development purposes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] list_cars( *, q: Optional[str] = None, year_min: Optional[int] = None, year_max: Optional[int] = None, price_min: Optional[float] = None, price_max: Optional[float] = None, sort_by: str = "year", sort_dir: str = "desc", page: int = 1, page_size: int = 12, )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of cars filtered by optional search parameters, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_car_by_id(car_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a single car's data as a dictionary, identified by its ID.
